sv.title: EU slopar biltullar – inför byråkratitullar
sv.summary: EU vill öppna handeln med USA, i detta är politiken verbalt tydlig. Men samtidigt agerar den politiska byråkratin i exakt motsatt riktning.Protektionism genom byråkrati öppnar ingen handel, den bara skadar alla involverade, skriver Jan Emanuel.

en.title: EU scraps car tariffs – introduces bureaucratic tariffs
en.summary: The EU wants to open trade with the USA, and in this the policy is verbally clear. But at the same time the political bureaucracy is acting in exactly the opposite direction. Protectionism through bureaucracy opens no trade, it only harms everyone involved, writes Jan Emanuel.
